item.text: I’ve identified a more substantive cleanup: split pattern compilation from text scanning. That removes repeated pattern setup work, makes the algorithm easier to reason about, and gives us a clearer internal API without changing the public one.
I’ve wired the internal split. I’m adding one regression that uses the compiled-pattern path directly, because that’s the new seam introduced by the refactor and it deserves coverage.
The new seam is covered. I’m compiling the production code and running the demo now to verify the refactor didn’t introduce any behavioral drift.
